description: This file defines the AppDatabase class, which serves as a Room database for the crypto tracker application, specifying the entities and version for the database.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as the Room database for the application, providing access to the CoinDao.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: A singleton method to get the instance of the AppDatabase, ensuring that only one instance exists at a time.

methods.name: coinDao
methods.description: An abstract method that returns a CoinDao instance for accessing coin data in the database.
